entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to make a return. I ordered a jersey a while back and it doesn't fit.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line Aero Jersey. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the fit?
It's just the wrong size for me. I ordered a medium, but it's much too tight across the shoulders. I'd like to do an exchange for a large if possible.

Of course. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered 38 days ago. That's unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for standard items, so processing that exchange is no problem at all.
Oh, that's great. I wasn't sure what the policy was. Thank you.
You're welcome. I've just initiated the exchange for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack up the original jersey and drop it off with the carrier.

Excellent. Now, since I do have to go through the trouble of repackaging this and taking it to the post office, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for a future order? For the inconvenience.

I understand the request. While our policy covers the free exchange for a different size, we aren't able to provide goodwill credits or discounts for sizing issues. My priority is to make sure we get you the right product, and the new jersey will ship out as soon as the original is scanned by the carrier.
Fair enough, I had to ask. I appreciate you making the exchange so easy. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
It's my pleasure. You should see that email with the label in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
